$comment: What a HealthKit sample means when it enters the reality vector.
This repo is the authority on that; the corpus can only record it. Supplied
as the lane metadata the ingress guardrails need — unit, value domain,
provenance class and staleness ceiling per lane position — so
RealityEngine_Machines can annotate the lanes its projector currently omits
for want of axis semantics. See localHealthkitBridge#9 and
Every value the bridge writes is normalised to [0,1] against a declared
source range, with the raw reading preserved in sample metadata. So the
canonical unit of every lane position is UCUM `1` — dimensionless — and
conversionPolicy is `prohibited`: rescaling a value that has already been
mapped onto a fixed range is not a unit conversion, it is a second
normalisation against a range the consumer does not know.
determinismRationale: Exogenous but reproducible under replay: a HealthKit sample is a reading
taken by a device, not a value generated by a model. ARBITER_CONTRACT.md
4.3a ranks measured(2) below deterministic(3) and above generated(1).
Misclassifying it upward would let a reading outrank a machine
determination; downward would let a generated assessment outrank a reading.

lanes.nameMismatch: The lane is named heart-rate; the bridge writes a blood-pressure family into it. Position 2 is the only heart-rate quantity.
The lane is named steps; the bridge writes an exercise family into it. Position 2 is the only step count.

lanes.stalenessRationale: Sleep is reported once per night; a ceiling shorter than a day would mark a correct sample stale.
